messages:
sofia: Quick ask — can someone run a short microbench on int4+fp8 for the 'long-tail-turn' prompt set? Seeing weird tail latency in prod yesterday.

arjun: I can run it. Do you want latency percentiles + sample outputs for quality? Also which model variant? int4 hybrid or pure int4?

sofia: Percentiles (P50/P95/P99) + a small quality diff vs baseline FP16. Variant: hybrid-int4-fp8 (kv-cache enabled). Use sequence len 1024 and the small promptset I linked earlier (https://redwood/internal/promptsets/long-tail-turn)

mike: Heads-up: autoscaler was flapping last night, might affect run consistency. Recommend pinning to 2 replicas for the bench.

lina: I can reserve 2 dedicated workers in staging for 30m, @mike will that avoid the autoscale noise?

mike: Yes, staging pool 3 has spare capacity. Lina go ahead.

arjun: Running now. Command:
```
bench-run --model hybrid-int4-fp8 --seq 1024 --dataset long-tail-turn --replicas 2 --samples 200 --metrics p50,p95,p99,throughput
```
I'll post results in ~15m.

ci-bot: Job queued: bench-1762345678, est runtime 12m. Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/bench-1762345678

sofia: thanks. Also include top-5 output diffs where token-level divergence occurs — we need to check hallucination/regression patterns.

arjun: ack. I'm saving the outputs to s3://redwood-qa/bench/1762345678 and will attach a CSV with per-sample BLEU/ROUGE-ish diffs.

arjun: Quick interim: P95 looks fine (~80ms) but P99 spiked to 420ms on 6 samples correlated with long decode loops. Attaching sample ids 7, 42, 183.

sofia: can you paste sample 42 output? curious if it's prompting causing loop.

arjun: Sample 42 (truncated): "... and then it kept repeating 'confirm' until the user said stop'" — seems model hallucinated a loop, probably beam/stop tokens issue.

mike: Could be our stop token handling mismatch with quantized variant. We saw earlier tokenization edge differences. Add a quick check: run the same sample in FP16 baseline.

arjun: Done. FP16 P99 for those samples stays ~95ms. So quantized path is producing longer decode due to more iterations.

lina: Ops note: the bench VM had a driver patch applied yesterday — I will roll it back in staging and rerun if needed.

sofia: Priority: if rerun fixes it then schedule a small canary with 5% traffic to hybrid-int4-fp8. If not, hold and open PR to adjust stopping heuristics.

arjun: I'll rerun after rollback. Also opening a quick PR with debug logs: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4281

mike: @arjun can you add a short perf regression test to qperf harness for this sample ids 7/42/183? Even a smoke that asserts P99 < 200ms.

arjun: Yes will add it — aiming to land by EOD.

sofia: Great. Thanks team :thumbsup:

lina: ping when rerun completes and I'll coordinate canary window.

ci-bot: Job completed: bench-1762345678 — artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/bench-1762345678/logs.zip

arjun: Rerun after rollback shows P99 back to ~110ms. Looks like driver patch was the culprit. I'll still land the qperf test.

sofia: Awesome — closing the loop. Please add a short blurb to the release notes about the driver sensitivity for quantized variants.

arjun: Will do.
